summary_1line: Krishna arrives at Indraprastha and tells Yudhishthira that Jarasandha’s dominance over many kings blocks the Rajasuya sacrifice unless he is defeated.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna arrives in a swift chariot at Indraprastha and is warmly received by Yudhishthira, Bhima, Arjuna, and Kunti.
Krishna sits with Yudhishthira in the palace chamber explaining how the powerful king Jarasandha has subdued many rulers of the earth.
A map-like vision of many kings and tribes bowing under the shadow of Jarasandha seated on the throne of Magadha.
